create.name: Dr. Ken Nelson
create.bio:
Dr. Ken Nelson has been leading groups since 1975 and is one of Kripalu's legacy faculty, having also served there as a scholar-in-residence. He earned an interdisciplinary doctorate at Tulane University and once lectured abroad as a Fulbright scholar. His own practice draws on gentle and yin yoga, qigong and taiji, guided relaxation, yoga nidra and simple meditation, and he is known for keeping all of it within reach of complete beginners. Over the years he has also developed programmes in Thai-Shiatsu bodywork and in yoga for later life, and his yin yoga audio and qigong video are long-standing titles in the Kripalu shop.

Much of his recent work is with people who lead groups themselves. Together with four collaborators, among them Lesli Lang and David Ronka, he wrote Designing & Leading Life-Changing Workshops, a practical handbook for teachers, coaches and retreat leaders on building sessions where people learn through experience rather than slides. The same team runs Life-Changing Workshops, which offers trainings, mentoring and free planning tools. Ken still leads restful Slow Yoga and Qigong retreats, including a New Year stay at Kripalu with Lesli Lang and qigong teacher John Haggerty, and he shares short guided meditations and chants on his website.

books.title: Designing & Leading Life-Changing Workshops: Creating the Conditions for Transformation in Your Groups, Trainings, and Retreats
books.author: Ken Nelson, David Ronka, Lesli Lang, Liz Korabek-Emerson, Jim White
books.description: A handbook for anyone who teaches groups, written by five longtime Kripalu presenters. It walks through planning a workshop, building trust in the room, handling group dynamics and making the learning last, with checklists and examples along the way.

courses.title: Slow Yoga and Qigong: Relax and Restore in the New Year
courses.description: A three-night New Year stay at Kripalu in Stockbridge, Massachusetts, led with John Haggerty and Lesli Lang. Days mix flowing qigong, slow yin and restorative yoga, yoga nidra and easy meditation, outdoors when the weather allows. No experience is needed.

courses.title: Designing and Leading Transformational Workshops: The Craft of Mind-Body Teaching
courses.description: A five-night residential training at Kripalu for teachers, coaches and facilitators, taught with co-authors Lesli Lang and David Ronka. It is based on their book and covers how people learn through experience, how to draw on a group's shared wisdom and how to practise leading in small groups. A workbook is included.

free_resources.title: Free Audios
free_resources.description: A page of short recordings by Ken, most under ten minutes. It includes guided breathing and relaxation, a gratitude practice, a meditation on softening judgement and several Sanskrit chants.

free_resources.title: The Workshop Leaders Toolkit
free_resources.description: A free companion to the team's book, offered as PDF and editable Word files. It holds planning checklists, worksheets, sample surveys and group agreements, and a template agenda for anyone putting together a workshop.
